abstract: Maintains onboard telematics verification and tailpipe particulate emissions monitoring records
system_message:
You are the Environmental compliance officer (ENV). Your business responsibilities include maintaining onboard telematics verification and tailpipe particulate emissions monitoring records, as well as tracking acoustic boundary monitoring data for concession candidates.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains onboard telematics verification and tailpipe particulate emissions monitoring records（ECO）
information_points.content:
ENV-ECO-GLI：For Harbor Rail Drayage Alliance, tailpipe emission monitoring is installed on all heavy trucks deployed under the concession, and testing indicates an average fleet soot particulate intensity of 12 mg/km across active tractor models during loaded harbor drayage duty cycles.
ENV-ECO-JPU：For Pacific Gateway Drayage Syndicate, operational confirmation verifies that tailpipe emission monitoring is installed across all heavy trucks deployed under the concession, and the fleet soot particulate intensity measured on certified chassis dynamometer tests during loaded harbor drayage duty cycles averages 16 mg/km.
ENV-ECO-NK1：For Cascadia Intermodal Transport Group, tailpipe emission monitoring is confirmed installed across all heavy trucks deployed under the concession, while certified chassis dynamometer testing reflects an average fleet soot particulate intensity of 28 mg/km during loaded harbor drayage duty cycles.

information_points.title: Acoustic boundary monitoring（NOISE）
information_points.content:
ENV-NOISE-FUR：According to acoustic sensor logs along the harbor boundary between 22:00 and 06:00, Harbor Rail Drayage Alliance registers a nighttime terminal decibel level of 52 dB during transfer operations.
ENV-NOISE-CPQ：Perimeter acoustic sensor logs record a nighttime terminal decibel level of 58 dB at the harbor boundary during transfer operations between 22:00 and 06:00 for Pacific Gateway Drayage Syndicate.
ENV-NOISE-L2E：Harbor boundary acoustic sensor monitoring indicates a nighttime terminal decibel level of 64 dB during transfer operations between 22:00 and 06:00 for Cascadia Intermodal Transport Group.
